# SignalFlow Studio

> Approval-first content operating system for turning meaningful work into evidence-backed content opportunities, exact review decisions, and reusable communication context.

## Current product truth

SignalFlow has an accepted browser-local owner path for manual ContentSignal → ContentOpportunity → angle judgment → NarrativeStrategy → ContentPiece → LinkedIn/X exact revision review.

Configured hosted owner flows also contain durable Postgres-backed record families for connected sources, ContentSignals, ProjectContext, Opportunities, identity/planning/review continuity, opportunity-job state, and private Assets.

Golden Path 2 — real GitHub work → worthwhile opportunity → automatic screenshot/evidence → exact owner review — is still an active acceptance gate. Do not describe it as production-complete solely because its foundations exist.

General hosted Campaign autosave, cross-device Campaign sync, collaboration, durable scheduled publication, broad automatic media production, and universal autoposting are not current finished capabilities.

## Capability sources

## Core behavior

- Not every Signal deserves content.
- The system may recommend silence or deferment.
- Not every destination deserves a variant.
- Approval binds an exact visible revision.
- Edits/regeneration invalidate relevant approval.
- GitHub App/webhooks provide ongoing GitHub source events; MCP is an agent-control interface.
- MCP reuses canonical application/API behavior rather than owning a second product state.
- Browser-local Campaign persistence and owner-scoped hosted Content OS records are distinct capability families.
- External publishing success is claimed only after the destination confirms it.
